title: State Machines & XState Basics
description: Model complex UI state with finite state machines and XState for predictable, bug-free state transitions.
longDescription: This module introduces finite state machines (FSM) and the XState library for managing complex UI state in React. You will learn why traditional boolean flags and scattered state updates lead to impossible states, how to model UI as state machines, and how to integrate XState with React components using the @xstate/react library.
whatYouLearn: Model UI state as finite state machines to eliminate impossible states
Create and interpret XState state machine definitions
Use statecharts for hierarchical and parallel states
Integrate XState machines with React components using useMachine
